# app/CLAUDE.md — Swift app rules

Applies to everything under `app/`. Build/verification commands and the FFI
lockstep are in the root `CLAUDE.md`; the full design is
`designs/spec/` (§3–4 the UI, §7.4–7.8 the platform side; its `README.md` is
the index). The
long form of each entry below — why each file is the shape it is, and the
traps its history turned up — is `designs/adr/app-file-history.md` (the
full history, every size toll and measurement, is archived; see its
"Original" line); this file is what governs a file now. Files
are listed by family; a file with a header comment of its own carries its
detail there.

## File map

**The core's edge.**

  core's speed range and audio ceiling, typed as `SpeedLimits` in
  `CoreValues.swift` — no Swift file types a speed bound), `ReelColor` (`rc_normalise_color`, G-25) and `ReelAgentSocket` (below);

  same call over n tracks with a project (`plan_zooms`, CU-70)) — `ReelCore+Framing.swift`
  holds `SpeakerMatch` and `ReelProject.speakerMatch` (`rc_project_speaker_match`, road map

  confirms) — and `ReelCore+Graphics.swift` the graphics engine's
  wrappers (below), with `ReelGraphicPackage` (`rc_graphic_package_write`, G-46; `read`,

**Frozen files.** `EditorViewController.swift`, `TimelineView.swift`,
`PreviewCanvasView.swift`, `AgentServer.swift` are **frozen at current
size**: anything adding more than ~50 lines goes in an extension file
(`EditorViewController+<Feature>.swift`, `TimelineView+<Feature>.swift`,
`AgentServer+<Feature>.swift`) or a new `…SheetController`, and the frozen
file keeps only the wiring — a stored property, a closure assignment, a
validator arm, a draw call. The pieces extension files build on are therefore
internal, not private. Pitfalls: a selector declared `@objc` on an extension
needs NO forward in the frozen file (a second declaration is an error); a
command whose body sits at the foot of a non-extension feature file carries
its validator arm there too, or the item falls through to the closing
`return true`; `handleEditorCharacter`'s bare-key `switch` matches in SOURCE
order, so a bare `case "x"` goes BELOW any modified `case "x" where …`; and
`handleEditorKey` refuses while a sheet is attached, because a sheet is
window-modal and the preview panel's forwarded keys would otherwise reach
the key map behind it.

1	// app/Sources/AgentServer+GraphicRender.swift — `render_graphic` (road map
2	// 10 §5h, G4b): a module drawn WITHOUT a clip, as a contact sheet of up to
3	// sixteen frames with each frame number printed under its cell, or as one
4	// frame's SVG text.
5	//
6	// **Runs on the SERVER thread** (`AgentServer.offMainTools`), `render_frame`'s
7	// posture: sixteen 4K frames are seconds of work, and freezing the UI for them
8	// is not acceptable. Every document touch is inside one `onMain` — the
9	// target, the module as the registry compiled it, the canvas — and the draw
10	// after it is the engine's, which is any-thread (`GraphicModule.svg`,
11	// `GraphicLibrary.rasterize`). The module is held for the whole call, and it
12	// holds its library strongly, so a rescan mid-call swaps the registry's set
13	// and not this one.
14	//
15	// **The ctx is the clip's, with no clip** (`recipe_graphic.rs`'s keys
16	// exactly): the canvas's fps, `durationInFrames` from `meta` (else 5 s at
17	// that rate, ceiled), the module's size from the caller, else `meta`, else
18	// the canvas — `add_graphic_clip`'s defaults — and the project's canvas.
19	// A frame that throws or will not rasterize is its error card on the sheet
20	// and a sentence in the reply; a warning is a sentence too.
21	//
22	// **`format` is read and checked first** (spec §11 G-19): with svg a
23	// non-null `path`, `background` or `max_width` — the png sheet's — is refused
24	// by name, before the multi-frame refusal, since svg answers text and writes
25	// no file. A frame at or past `durationInFrames` is DRAWN, not refused, with
26	// `progress` clamped at 1: a clip longer than its length draws those frames
27	// too (G-9, G-19 (b)). A png sheet past `GraphicContactSheet.maxCellPixels`
28	// of frames is refused once the size is known, before any frame is drawn
29	// or any file written (G-20 (d)).
30	
31	import Foundation
32	
33	extension AgentServer {
34	
35	    /// `render_graphic` — UI path: none — the preview well is a person's
36	    /// picture; §5j builds no strip.
37	    func renderGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
38	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
39	        let frames = try graphicFrames(a)
40	        let propsJSON = try graphicPropsJSON(a)
41	        let requestedWidth = try graphicSide(a, "width")
42	        let requestedHeight = try graphicSide(a, "height")
43	        let format = try stringArg(a, "format") ?? "png"
44	        guard format == "png" || format == "svg" else {
45	            throw ToolError(message: "format must be png or svg (got \"\(format)\").")
46	        }
47	        if format == "svg" {
48	            let sheetOnly = ["path", "background", "max_width"].filter {
49	                a[$0].map { !($0 is NSNull) } ?? false
50	            }
51	            if !sheetOnly.isEmpty {
52	                throw ToolError(
53	                    message: "format svg takes no path, background or max_width — those are the "
54	                        + "png contact sheet's; svg answers one frame's SVG text in the reply and "
55	                        + "writes no file (got \(sheetOnly.joined(separator: ", "))).")
56	            }
57	            if frames.count > 1 {
58	                throw ToolError(
59	                    message: "format svg answers ONE frame's SVG, and frames names "
60	                        + "\(frames.count); ask for one frame, or for a png contact sheet.")
61	            }
62	        }
63	        let maxWidth = try intArg(a, "max_width") ?? GraphicContactSheet.maxWidthDefault
64	        let widths = GraphicContactSheet.maxWidthMin...GraphicContactSheet.maxSide
65	        guard widths.contains(maxWidth) else {
66	            throw ToolError(
67	                message: "max_width must be \(widths.lowerBound)…\(widths.upperBound) px "
68	                    + "(got \(maxWidth)).")
69	        }
70	        let backgroundName = try stringArg(a, "background") ?? "transparent"
71	        guard let background = GraphicSheetBackground(backgroundName) else {
72	            throw ToolError(
73	                message: "background must be \(GraphicSheetBackground.accepted) "
74	                    + "(got \"\(backgroundName)\").")
75	        }
76	        let url = format == "png" ? try graphicSheetDestination(a, name: name) : nil
77	
78	        let context = try onMain {
79	            () throws -> (module: GraphicModule, width: Int, height: Int, fps: Fps,
80	                canvas: CanvasSnapshot, frames: Int) in
81	            let document = try self.target(a)
82	            let compiled = try self.compiledModule(named: name, document)
83	            let canvas = document.project.snapshot.canvas
84	            let tick = max(canvas.fps.frameDuration, 1)
85	            let width = try requestedWidth.map(Int.init)
86	                ?? Self.metaWhole(compiled.meta, "width", name, in: Self.sides) ?? canvas.width
87	            let height = try requestedHeight.map(Int.init)
88	                ?? Self.metaWhole(compiled.meta, "height", name, in: Self.sides) ?? canvas.height
89	            let length = try Self.metaWhole(
90	                compiled.meta, "durationInFrames", name, in: 1...Int.max / Int(tick))
91	                ?? Int((5 * canvas.fps.double).rounded(.up))
92	            return (compiled.module, width, height, canvas.fps, canvas, length)
93	        }
94	        let pixels = frames.count * context.width * context.height
95	        if format == "png", pixels > GraphicContactSheet.maxCellPixels {
96	            throw ToolError(
97	                message: "A contact sheet draws at most \(GraphicContactSheet.maxCellPixels) px of "
98	                    + "frames; \(frames.count) frame(s) of \(context.width)×\(context.height) are "
99	                    + "\(pixels) px — ask for fewer frames or a smaller width and height.")
100	        }
101	
102	        var reports: [GraphicReport] = []
103	        var cells: [GraphicSheetCell] = []
104	        for frame in frames {
105	            let ctx = Self.graphicContext(
106	                frame: frame, fps: context.fps, length: context.frames, width: context.width,
107	                height: context.height, canvas: context.canvas)
108	            let drawn: (svg: String, warnings: [GraphicDiagnostic])
109	            do {
110	                drawn = try context.module.svg(
111	                    frame: frame, propsJSON: propsJSON, ctxJSON: Self.jsonText(ctx),
112	                    budgetMs: GraphicRegistry.offlineBudgetMs)
113	            } catch {
114	                let diagnostics = GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
115	                if format == "svg" {
116	                    return try svgReply(name, frame, nil, diagnostics, ctx)
117	                }
118	                reports.append(
119	                    GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: true, diagnostics: diagnostics))
120	                cells.append(Self.cardCell(name, frame, diagnostics))
121	                continue
122	            }
123	            if format == "svg" {
124	                return try svgReply(name, frame, drawn.svg, drawn.warnings, ctx)
125	            }
126	            if !drawn.warnings.isEmpty {
127	                reports.append(
128	                    GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: false, diagnostics: drawn.warnings))
129	            }
130	            do {
131	                let raster = try context.module.library.rasterize(
132	                    drawn.svg, width: context.width, height: context.height)
133	                if !raster.warnings.isEmpty {
134	                    reports.append(GraphicReport(
135	                        name: name, frame: frame, failed: false, diagnostics: raster.warnings))
136	                }
137	                cells.append(GraphicSheetCell(frame: frame, image: raster.cgImage(), cardText: nil))
138	            } catch {
139	                let diagnostics = GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
140	                reports.append(
141	                    GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: true, diagnostics: diagnostics))
142	                cells.append(Self.cardCell(name, frame, diagnostics))
143	            }
144	        }
145	
146	        let layout = GraphicContactSheet.layout(
147	            count: cells.count, cellWidth: context.width, cellHeight: context.height,
148	            maxWidth: maxWidth)
149	        guard let url = url,
150	            let sheet = GraphicContactSheet.paint(cells, layout: layout, background: background)
151	        else {
152	            throw ToolError(
153	                message: "The contact sheet of \(layout.width)×\(layout.height) px could not be "
154	                    + "painted.")
155	        }
156	        do {
157	            try FrameWriter.write(sheet, as: .png, to: url)
158	        } catch {
159	            throw ToolError(message: error.localizedDescription)
160	        }
161	        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url) else {
162	            throw ToolError(message: "Wrote \(url.path) but could not read it back.")
163	        }
164	        let listed = frames.map(String.init).joined(separator: ", ")
165	        var text = "Contact sheet of \(frames.count) frame(s) of \"\(name)\" — frames \(listed) — "
166	            + "each \(context.width)×\(context.height) px at scale "
167	            + String(format: "%g", layout.scale)
168	            + " on \(layout.columns)×\(layout.rows), \(layout.width)×\(layout.height) px, "
169	            + "background \(backgroundName)."
170	        for report in reports {
171	            text += " " + Self.graphicSentence(report)
172	        }
173	        text += " Written to \(url.path)."
174	        return try callResult(
175	            content: [
176	                ["type": "image", "data": data.base64EncodedString(), "mimeType": "image/png"],
177	                ["type": "text", "text": text],
178	            ], isError: false)
179	    }
180	
181	    /// `frames` (1…16 whole numbers ≥ 0) or `frame`, never both; `[0]` for
182	    /// neither.
183	    private func graphicFrames(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> [Int] {
184	        let single = try intArg(a, "frame")
185	        let listed = a["frames"].flatMap { $0 is NSNull ? nil : $0 }
186	        if single != nil, listed != nil {
187	            throw ToolError(message: "frame and frames are exclusive — pass one or the other.")
188	        }
189	        if let single = single {
190	            guard single >= 0 else { throw ToolError(message: "frame must be 0 or more: \(single).") }
191	            return [single]
192	        }
193	        guard let listed = listed else { return [0] }
194	        let limit = GraphicContactSheet.maxFrames
195	        guard let list = listed as? [Any], (1...limit).contains(list.count) else {
196	            throw ToolError(message: "frames must be a list of 1 to \(limit) frame numbers.")
197	        }
198	        return try list.enumerated().map { index, raw in
199	            guard let number = raw as? NSNumber, CFGetTypeID(number) != CFBooleanGetTypeID(),
200	                let whole = AgentServer.whole(number), whole >= 0
201	            else {
202	                throw ToolError(
203	                    message: "frames[\(index)] must be a whole frame number of 0 or more "
204	                        + "(got \(AgentServer.describe(raw))).")
205	            }
206	            return whole
207	        }
208	    }
209	
210	    /// `props` as the JSON text the engine takes; `{}` when absent.
211	    private func graphicPropsJSON(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
212	        guard let raw = a["props"], !(raw is NSNull) else { return "{}" }
213	        guard let props = raw as? [String: Any] else {
214	            throw ToolError(message: "props must be an object keyed by the schema's names")
215	        }
216	        return Self.jsonText(props)
217	    }
218	
219	    /// Where the sheet is written: `path` through `destinationURL` as a
220	    /// `.png`, its folder required to exist; else a temporary file.
221	    private func graphicSheetDestination(_ a: [String: Any], name: String) throws -> URL {
222	        guard let path = try stringArg(a, "path") else {
223	            return Self.temporaryOutput("framejob-graphic-\(name)", extension: "png")
224	        }
225	        return try Self.requireFolder(
226	            of: Self.destinationURL(try Self.nonEmptyOutputPath(path), extension: "png"))
227	    }
228	
229	    /// `recipe_graphic.rs`'s ctx for `frame` of a `length`-frame graphic.
230	    static func graphicContext(
231	        frame: Int, fps: Fps, length: Int, width: Int, height: Int, canvas: CanvasSnapshot
232	    ) -> [String: Any] {
233	        let rate = fps.double
234	        let progress = min(max(Double(frame) / Double(max(length - 1, 1)), 0), 1)
235	        return [
236	            "fps": rate, "time": rate > 0 ? Double(frame) / rate : 0,
237	            "durationInFrames": length, "progress": progress,
238	            "width": width, "height": height,
239	            "canvas": ["width": canvas.width, "height": canvas.height],
240	        ]
241	    }
242	
243	    /// The `svg` format's answer: one frame's text, or why there is none.
244	    private func svgReply(
245	        _ name: String, _ frame: Int, _ svg: String?, _ diagnostics: [GraphicDiagnostic],
246	        _ ctx: [String: Any]
247	    ) throws -> String {
248	        try jsonResult([
249	            "name": name, "frame": frame, "ok": svg != nil, "svg": svg ?? NSNull(),
250	            "diagnostics": diagnostics.map(Self.diagnosticJSON), "ctx": ctx,
251	        ])
252	    }
253	
254	    private static func cardCell(
255	        _ name: String, _ frame: Int, _ diagnostics: [GraphicDiagnostic]
256	    ) -> GraphicSheetCell {
257	        GraphicSheetCell(
258	            frame: frame, image: nil,
259	            cardText: LayerRenderers.errorCardText(
260	                name: name, frame: frame, diagnostic: diagnostics.first))
261	    }
262	
263	    private static func jsonText(_ object: [String: Any]) -> String {
264	        guard let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: object) else { return "{}" }
265	        return String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self)
266	    }
267	}

1	// app/Sources/AgentServer+Graphics.swift — the two graphic OP tools (road map
2	// 10 §5h, G3b): `add_graphic_clip` and `set_graphic`; and G4a's three
3	// app-state tools, the agent's write/read loop over the package's
4	// `graphics/`: `write_graphic`, `get_graphic` and `graphic_reference`, with
5	// `graphicsSummary`, which `get_project` reports as `graphics`. G4b's three
6	// are next door: `render_graphic` in `AgentServer+GraphicRender.swift`, the
7	// two imports in `AgentServer+GraphicImports.swift`; and issue batch B84's
8	// three — `delete_graphic`, `rename_graphic`, `restore_graphic` — in
9	// `AgentServer+GraphicFiles.swift`.
10	//
11	// **The app fills `schema`, and only the app can** (G-4): the core has no
12	// filesystem, so the schema a `props` patch is checked against is read here
13	// from the module's CURRENT revision — `GraphicRegistry`'s compiled entry for
14	// the document — and sent with the op. The tool does not publish `schema`
15	// (`AgentCatalog+Declarations.swift`'s `.filledByTheApp` rows), so the gate
16	// refuses a caller's own as a stranger before a handler runs.
17	//
18	// What this side refuses is what the core cannot know: a module the folder
19	// does not hold, a module that did not compile, and a `meta` value that
20	// cannot be a duration or a side. Every rule about the props themselves is
21	// the core's sentence.
22	
23	import Foundation
24	
25	extension AgentServer {
26	
27	    /// `add_graphic_clip` — UI path: Insert ▸ Graphic…'s Insert, which is
28	    /// `write_graphic` of a template (or a chosen `.js`) then this op
29	    /// (`EditorViewController+GraphicMenus.swift`).
30	    ///
31	    /// `duration`, `width` and `height` default from the module's `meta`
32	    /// (`durationInFrames` at the canvas rate; `width` / `height`), and
33	    /// past that to the core's own defaults (5 s; the canvas).
34	    func addGraphicClip(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
35	        let document = try target(a)
36	        let track = try trackArg(a, "track", document)
37	        let at = try timeArg(a, "at", document)
38	        let duration = try optionalTimeArg(a, "duration", document)
39	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
40	        let width = try graphicSide(a, "width")
41	        let height = try graphicSide(a, "height")
42	        let props = a["props"]
43	        let (_, meta, schema) = try compiledModule(named: name, document)
44	        let frame = max(document.project.snapshot.canvas.fps.frameDuration, 1)
45	        // `meta` is only the fallback: a caller's own `duration` is never
46	        // refused for a `durationInFrames` it does not use.
47	        let metaDuration: Ticks? = try duration != nil ? nil
48	            : Self.metaWhole(meta, "durationInFrames", name, in: 1...Int.max / Int(frame))
49	                .map { Ticks($0) * frame }
50	        return try editResult(
51	            document, "Add Graphic",
52	            [.addGraphicClipRaw(
53	                track: track.id, at: at, duration: duration ?? metaDuration, name: name,
54	                width: try width
55	                    ?? Self.metaWhole(meta, "width", name, in: Self.sides).map(UInt32.init),
56	                height: try height
57	                    ?? Self.metaWhole(meta, "height", name, in: Self.sides).map(UInt32.init),
58	                props: props, schema: schema)])
59	    }
60	
61	    /// `set_graphic` — UI path: the Graphic sub-tab, Properties/Size/Timeline
62	    /// (GraphicPane.swift).
63	    ///
64	    /// A patch that carries `props` or `name` is checked against a schema:
65	    /// the patch's own `name`'s, else the one module every clip shares.
66	    func setGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
67	        let document = try target(a)
68	        let clips = try clipsArg(a, "clips", document)
69	        let patch = try rawPatchArg(a, "patch")
70	        var schema: [String: Any]?
71	        if let fields = patch as? [String: Any], fields["props"] != nil || fields["name"] != nil {
72	            let name: String
73	            if let named = fields["name"] as? String {
74	                name = named
75	            } else {
76	                let scope = try idScope(document)
77	                let names = Set(clips.compactMap { scope.clip($0)?.graphic?.name })
78	                guard names.count <= 1 else {
79	                    let listed = names.sorted().map { "\"\($0)\"" }.joined(separator: " and ")
80	                    throw ToolError(
81	                        message: "The clips are drawn by different modules (\(listed)); "
82	                            + "set props on one module's clips at a time.")
83	                }
84	                name = names.first ?? ""
85	            }
86	            if !name.isEmpty { schema = try compiledModule(named: name, document).schema }
87	        }
88	        return try editResult(
89	            document, "Graphic Properties",
90	            [.setGraphicRaw(clips: clips, patch: patch, schema: schema)])
91	    }
92	
93	    // MARK: - The write/read loop (G4a)
94	
95	    static let notUndoableNote = "not undoable; keep your own copy if you want the old one back"
96	
97	    /// `write_graphic` — UI path: the file on disk (an external editor);
98	    /// Insert ▸ Graphic…'s sheet, which writes a template or a chosen `.js` through
99	    /// the same `store.write` then places it (`add_graphic_clip`); and
100	    /// Duplicate as New Graphic…, which writes the copy through the same
101	    /// `store.write` then repoints with `set_graphic {name}`.
102	    ///
103	    /// Writes `graphics/<name>.js` through the store's one writer, then
104	    /// rescans at once, so the registry has compiled THAT text before the
105	    /// reply is built: a failed compile is an answer (`ok` false with its
106	    /// diagnostics), not an error. Not undoable and never dirty (G-3); the
107	    /// text it replaced is kept by that rescan's pass, and `kept` lists the
108	    /// module's kept revisions, newest first (G-29).
109	    func writeGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
110	        let document = try target(a)
111	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
112	        let source = try requiredString(a, "source")
113	        let store = try graphicStore(document)
114	        do {
115	            try store.write(name: name, source: source)
116	        } catch let error as ReelCoreError {
117	            throw ToolError(message: error.message)
118	        } catch {
119	            throw ToolError(
120	                message: "graphics/\(name).js could not be written: \(error.localizedDescription)")
121	        }
122	        store.rescan()
123	        guard store.module(named: name) != nil else {
124	            throw ToolError(
125	                message: "graphics/\(name).js was written but the folder's scan does not list it "
126	                    + "— graphics/ may not be readable by Frame Job, or was replaced mid-write; "
127	                    + "get_graphic {} shows what the scan sees")
128	        }
129	        var result = moduleReport(named: name, document)
130	        result["name"] = name
131	        result["kept"] = store.kept(named: name).map(\.revision)
132	        result["note"] = Self.keptNote
133	        return try jsonResult(result)
134	    }
135	
136	    /// `get_graphic` — UI path: the Graphic sub-tab, Source section
137	    /// (GraphicPane+Source.swift).
138	    ///
139	    /// With `name`, one module as the folder holds it now: its source, its
140	    /// revision, its compile and `kept`, its kept revisions newest first.
141	    /// Without, where the folder is, what it holds, `warnings`: what its
142	    /// scan skipped or could not watch (G-24 (b)), and `history`: every
143	    /// name with a kept revision, deleted modules included (G-29 (e)).
144	    func getGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
145	        let document = try target(a)
146	        let store = try graphicStore(document)
147	        guard let name = try stringArg(a, "name") else {
148	            return try jsonResult([
149	                "folder": store.folderURL.path,
150	                "folder_exists": FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: store.folderURL.path),
151	                "modules": graphicsSummary(document),
152	                "families": libraryFamilies(document),
153	                "assets": store.scan.assets.map(\.name),
154	                "warnings": store.scan.warnings,
155	                "history": store.keptNames().map { kept -> [String: Any] in
156	                    ["name": kept, "kept": store.kept(named: kept).map(\.revision)]
157	                },
158	            ])
159	        }
160	        guard let file = store.module(named: name) else {
161	            throw ToolError(message: noModuleSentence(name, document))
162	        }
163	        var result = moduleReport(named: name, document)
164	        result["name"] = name
165	        result["source"] = String(decoding: file.bytes, as: UTF8.self)
166	        result["kept"] = store.kept(named: name).map(\.revision)
167	        return try jsonResult(result)
168	    }
169	
170	    /// `graphic_reference` — UI path: Help ▸ Graphics Reference, which
171	    /// opens the same file (`AppDelegate+GraphicMenu.swift`).
172	    ///
173	    /// The bundled `GraphicsAPI.md`, verbatim. Needs no open document, so
174	    /// it calls `target(a)` only when given `project`, to refuse a path no
175	    /// open project is at (spec §11 G-20 (e)).
176	    func graphicReference(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
177	        if let project = a["project"], !(project is NSNull) { _ = try target(a) }
178	        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: GraphicStore.bundledReferenceURL) else {
179	            throw ToolError(
180	                message: "The bundled reference GraphicsAPI.md is missing from the app's Resources")
181	        }
182	        return try callResult(
183	            content: [["type": "text", "text": String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self)]],
184	            isError: false)
185	    }
186	
187	    /// `[{name, revision, ok, clips}]` by name over the store's scan; `[]`
188	    /// with no store. `get_project`'s `graphics`.
189	    func graphicsSummary(_ document: ProjectDocument) -> [[String: Any]] {
190	        guard let store = document.graphicStore else { return [] }
191	        return store.scan.modules.values.sorted { $0.name < $1.name }.map { file in
192	            let ok: Bool
193	            if case .compiled = GraphicRegistry.shared.entry(

197	            } else {

224	    /// the scan holds; a compiled module's diagnostics are what its top level

239	        case .failed(let diagnostics, _):

1	// app/Sources/GraphicContactSheet.swift — `render_graphic`'s contact sheet
2	// (road map 10 §5h, G4b): the frames of one module laid out on a grid, each
3	// with its frame number printed in a strip under it. Pure: cells in, one
4	// `CGImage` out; no document, no file, no thread of its own.
5	//
6	// **The scale is over the CELLS alone** (G4b's objection 2): the gaps and
7	// the label strips are drawn at full size and never scaled, so the bound
8	// they are subtracted from is exactly the sheet's size — `width ≤ maxWidth`
9	// and `height ≤ maxSide` hold by construction.
10	//
11	// **At scale 1 a cell is the raster's own bytes**: drawn at its exact pixel
12	// size and an integer origin, so no resampling touches it and a proof can
13	// compare it with `render_frame`'s picture pixel for pixel. A cell whose
14	// frame failed is the error card, through the one painter
15	// (`LayerRenderers.paintErrorCard`).
16	
17	import AppKit
18	import CoreText
19	
20	/// What the sheet is painted on before the cells.
21	enum GraphicSheetBackground {
22	    case transparent, checker, color(CGColor)
23	
24	    static let accepted = "transparent, checker, or a hex colour (#rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa)"
25	
26	    /// `transparent`, `checker`, or `#rgb` / `#rrggbb` / `#rrggbbaa`, in any
27	    /// case; nil for anything else.
28	    init?(_ argument: String) {
29	        let lowered = argument.lowercased()
30	        switch lowered {
31	        case "transparent":
32	            self = .transparent
33	        case "checker":
34	            self = .checker
35	        default:
36	            guard lowered.hasPrefix("#") else { return nil }
37	            let hex = Array(lowered.dropFirst())
38	            guard [3, 6, 8].contains(hex.count), hex.allSatisfy(\.isHexDigit) else { return nil }
39	            let digits = hex.count == 3 ? hex.flatMap { [$0, $0] } : hex
40	            var channels = stride(from: 0, to: digits.count, by: 2).map { at -> CGFloat in
41	                CGFloat(UInt8(String(digits[at...at + 1]), radix: 16) ?? 0) / 255
42	            }
43	            if channels.count == 3 { channels.append(1) }
44	            self = .color(CGColor(
45	                srgbRed: channels[0], green: channels[1], blue: channels[2], alpha: channels[3]))
46	        }
47	    }
48	}
49	
50	/// One cell: the frame it shows and either its picture or its card's text.
51	struct GraphicSheetCell {
52	    let frame: Int
53	    let image: CGImage?
54	    let cardText: String?
55	}
56	
57	enum GraphicContactSheet {
58	    static let gap = 8, labelHeight = 24, maxWidthDefault = 2048, maxWidthMin = 64
59	    static let maxFrames = 16, maxSide = GraphicLibrary.maxSide
60	    /// The most pixels of frames a png sheet draws (spec §11 G-20 (d)):
61	    /// every cell's raster is held until paint. Two 8192² frames, or
62	    /// sixteen 3840×2160.
63	    static let maxCellPixels = 2 * maxSide * maxSide
64	
65	    /// Where every cell goes. Row-major from the top left, no outer margin.
66	    struct Layout {
67	        let columns, rows: Int
68	        let scale: Double
69	        let cellWidth, cellHeight, width, height: Int
70	
71	        /// Cell `index`'s top-left corner, y down.
72	        func origin(of index: Int) -> (x: Int, y: Int) {
73	            let column = index % columns, row = index / columns
74	            return (
75	                column * (cellWidth + GraphicContactSheet.gap),
76	                row * (cellHeight + GraphicContactSheet.labelHeight + GraphicContactSheet.gap))
77	        }
78	    }
79	
80	    /// `count` cells of `cellWidth`×`cellHeight` on a near-square grid, the
81	    /// cells scaled down (never up) so the sheet is at most `maxWidth` wide
82	    /// and `maxSide` tall.
83	    static func layout(count: Int, cellWidth: Int, cellHeight: Int, maxWidth: Int) -> Layout {
84	        let count = max(count, 1)
85	        var columns = 1
86	        while columns * columns < count { columns += 1 }
87	        let rows = (count + columns - 1) / columns
88	        let byWidth = Double(maxWidth - (columns - 1) * gap) / Double(columns * cellWidth)
89	        let byHeight = Double(maxSide - rows * labelHeight - (rows - 1) * gap)
90	            / Double(rows * cellHeight)
91	        let scale = min(1, byWidth, byHeight)
92	        let drawnWidth = max(1, Int((Double(cellWidth) * scale).rounded(.down)))
93	        let drawnHeight = max(1, Int((Double(cellHeight) * scale).rounded(.down)))
94	        return Layout(
95	            columns: columns, rows: rows, scale: scale,
96	            cellWidth: drawnWidth, cellHeight: drawnHeight,
97	            width: columns * drawnWidth + (columns - 1) * gap,
98	            height: rows * (drawnHeight + labelHeight) + (rows - 1) * gap)
99	    }
100	
101	    /// The sheet: `background`, then each cell at `layout`'s place with its
102	    /// label strip under it. Premultiplied BGRA in sRGB, exactly
103	    /// `layout.width`×`layout.height`.
104	    static func paint(
105	        _ cells: [GraphicSheetCell], layout: Layout, background: GraphicSheetBackground
106	    ) -> CGImage? {
107	        guard let space = CGColorSpace(name: CGColorSpace.sRGB),
108	            let context = CGContext(
109	                data: nil, width: layout.width, height: layout.height, bitsPerComponent: 8,
110	                bytesPerRow: 0, space: space,
111	                bitmapInfo: CGImageAlphaInfo.premultipliedFirst.rawValue
112	                    | CGBitmapInfo.byteOrder32Little.rawValue)
113	        else { return nil }
114	        let whole = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: layout.width, height: layout.height)
115	        switch background {
116	        case .transparent:
117	            context.clear(whole)
118	        case .color(let color):
119	            context.setFillColor(color)
120	            context.fill(whole)
121	        case .checker:
122	            paintChecker(context, width: layout.width, height: layout.height)
123	        }
124	        context.interpolationQuality = layout.scale < 1 ? .high : .none
125	        for (index, cell) in cells.enumerated() {
126	            let (x, top) = layout.origin(of: index)
127	            // Core Graphics is y up: the cell's bottom edge, from the top-left place.
128	            let rect = CGRect(
129	                x: x, y: layout.height - top - layout.cellHeight,
130	                width: layout.cellWidth, height: layout.cellHeight)
131	            if let text = cell.cardText {
132	                LayerRenderers.paintErrorCard(text, in: context, bounds: rect)
133	            } else if let image = cell.image {
134	                context.draw(image, in: rect)
135	            }
136	            paintLabel(
137	                cell.frame, in: context,
138	                strip: CGRect(
139	                    x: rect.minX, y: rect.minY - CGFloat(labelHeight), width: rect.width,
140	                    height: CGFloat(labelHeight)))
141	        }
142	        return context.makeImage()
143	    }
144	
145	    /// 16 px squares of (128,128,128) and (192,192,192), from the top left.
146	    static func paintChecker(_ context: CGContext, width: Int, height: Int) {
147	        let side = 16
148	        context.setFillColor(CGColor(srgbRed: 128 / 255, green: 128 / 255, blue: 128 / 255, alpha: 1))
149	        context.fill(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: width, height: height))
150	        context.setFillColor(CGColor(srgbRed: 192 / 255, green: 192 / 255, blue: 192 / 255, alpha: 1))
151	        for row in 0...(height / side) {
152	            for column in 0...(width / side) where (row + column) % 2 == 1 {
153	                context.fill(CGRect(
154	                    x: column * side, y: height - (row + 1) * side, width: side, height: side))
155	            }
156	        }
157	    }
158	
159	    /// The frame number in white `DS.mono(13)` on an opaque (30,30,30) strip,
160	    /// clipped to the strip.
161	    private static func paintLabel(_ frame: Int, in context: CGContext, strip: CGRect) {
162	        context.saveGState()
163	        defer { context.restoreGState() }
164	        context.clip(to: strip)
165	        context.setFillColor(CGColor(srgbRed: 30 / 255, green: 30 / 255, blue: 30 / 255, alpha: 1))
166	        context.fill(strip)
167	        let attributed = NSAttributedString(
168	            string: String(frame),
169	            attributes: [.font: DS.mono(13), .foregroundColor: NSColor.white])
170	        let line = CTLineCreateWithAttributedString(attributed)
171	        context.setFillColor(CGColor(srgbRed: 1, green: 1, blue: 1, alpha: 1))
172	        context.textMatrix = .identity
173	        context.textPosition = CGPoint(x: strip.minX + 6, y: strip.minY + 7)
174	        CTLineDraw(line, context)
175	    }
176	}
177	
178	extension GraphicRaster {
179	    /// The raster as a `CGImage`: premultiplied BGRA in sRGB, rows `stride`
180	    /// bytes apart — the layout the engine wrote, so nothing is converted.
181	    func cgImage() -> CGImage? {
182	        guard width > 0, height > 0, let space = CGColorSpace(name: CGColorSpace.sRGB),
183	            let provider = CGDataProvider(data: Data(bgra) as CFData)
184	        else { return nil }
185	        return CGImage(
186	            width: width, height: height, bitsPerComponent: 8, bitsPerPixel: 32,
187	            bytesPerRow: stride, space: space,
188	            bitmapInfo: CGBitmapInfo(
189	                rawValue: CGImageAlphaInfo.premultipliedFirst.rawValue
190	                    | CGBitmapInfo.byteOrder32Little.rawValue),
191	            provider: provider, decode: nil, shouldInterpolate: false, intent: .defaultIntent)
192	    }
193	}

1	// app/Sources/AgentServer+GraphicBrowser.swift — `list_graphics` and
2	// `insert_graphic` (spec §11 G-45): the Insert ▸ Graphic… sheet's two acts
3	// for an agent — what its two lists show, and its Insert.
4	//
5	// **The list is the sheet's** (`GraphicCatalog.categories(for:)`): the same
6	// categories in the same order, the same titles — a This Project duplicate
7	// told apart by its module name — and the same `ok`.
8	//
9	// **Insert is the sheet's bodies** (`ProjectDocument+GraphicInsert.swift`):
10	// a template is written into `graphics/` under a free name, a This Project
11	// module is placed as it is, and the clip goes where Add Text's does
12	// (`EditorViewController.generatedClipOps`). The edit is `editResult`'s, so
13	// it is one closed undo step "Insert Graphic" and, with a nest open, lands
14	// inside it as the sheet's does. What this side refuses names the CALL
15	// (spec §11 D2-1): a `from` that is neither origin, a name that origin does
16	// not hold, and a document with no window.
17	//
18	// **`export_graphic` is the sheet's Export…** (spec §11 G-46): the graphic
19	// resolved as `insert_graphic` resolves it (`browserGraphic`, its refusals),
20	// its `GraphicPackageJob` built inside `onMain`, and the package written on
21	// the SERVER thread (`AgentServer.offMainTools`), `render_graphic`'s posture,
22	// since drawing every frame is seconds of QuickJS. It is no edit.
23	
24	import Foundation
25	
26	extension AgentServer {
27	
28	    /// `list_graphics` — UI path: Insert ▸ Graphic…'s two lists.
29	    func listGraphics(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
30	        let document = try target(a)
31	        let categories = GraphicCatalog.categories(for: document).map { category in
32	            [
33	                "name": category.name,
34	                "graphics": category.items.map { item in
35	                    [
36	                        "name": item.name, "title": item.title,
37	                        "description": item.description ?? NSNull(),
38	                        "category": item.category, "from": item.origin.rawValue, "ok": item.ok,
39	                    ] as [String: Any]
40	                },
41	            ] as [String: Any]
42	        }
43	        return try jsonResult(["categories": categories])
44	    }
45	
46	    /// What `name` and `from` name in Insert ▸ Graphic…'s lists.
47	    enum BrowserGraphic {
48	        case template(GraphicTemplateLibrary.Entry)
49	        case project(String)
50	    }
51	
52	    /// `name` resolved in the origin `from` names, refused in `insert_graphic`'s sentences:
53	    /// a `from` that is neither origin, a document with no window, a name that origin does
54	    /// not hold. Main.
55	    func browserGraphic(
56	        name: String, from: String, document: ProjectDocument
57	    ) throws -> BrowserGraphic {
58	        guard let origin = GraphicBrowserItem.Origin(rawValue: from) else {
59	            throw ToolError(message: "from must be template or project (got \"\(from)\").")
60	        }
61	        guard editor(document) != nil, let store = document.graphicStore else {
62	            throw ToolError(message: ProjectDocument.noGraphicsFolderSentence)
63	        }
64	        switch origin {
65	        case .template:
66	            let templates = GraphicTemplateLibrary.shared.entries
67	            guard let template = templates.first(where: { $0.template.name == name }) else {
68	                throw ToolError(
69	                    message: "No template named \"\(name)\" — the templates are: "
70	                        + templates.map(\.template.name).joined(separator: ", "))
71	            }
72	            return .template(template)
73	        case .project:
74	            guard store.module(named: name) != nil else {
75	                let held = store.scan.modules.keys.sorted()
76	                throw ToolError(
77	                    message: "No module named \"\(name)\" in this project's graphics/ — it "
78	                        + "holds: " + (held.isEmpty ? "nothing" : held.joined(separator: ", ")))
79	            }
80	            return .project(name)
81	        }
82	    }
83	
84	    /// `insert_graphic` — UI path: Insert ▸ Graphic…'s Insert.
85	    func insertGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
86	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
87	        let from = try requiredString(a, "from")
88	        let document = try target(a)
89	        let graphic = try browserGraphic(name: name, from: from, document: document)
90	        let placed: String
91	        do {
92	            switch graphic {
93	            case .template(let template):
94	                placed = try document.writeGraphicModule(from: template.template.url)
95	            case .project(let module):
96	                placed = module
97	            }
98	            let make = try document.graphicClipMaker(named: placed)
99	            let ops = EditorViewController.generatedClipOps(in: document, make)
100	            return try editResult(document, "Insert Graphic", ops, ["name": placed])
101	        } catch let error as ReelCoreError {
102	            throw ToolError(message: error.message)
103	        }
104	    }
105	
106	    /// `export_graphic` — UI path: Insert ▸ Graphic…'s Export…. Runs off main.
107	    func exportGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
108	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
109	        let from = try requiredString(a, "from")
110	        let path = try requiredString(a, "path")
111	        let url = try Self.requireFolder(
112	            of: Self.destinationURL(
113	                try Self.nonEmptyOutputPath(path), extension: GraphicPackage.fileExtension))
114	        let job = try onMain { () throws -> GraphicPackageJob in
115	            let document = try self.target(a)
116	            let graphic = try self.browserGraphic(name: name, from: from, document: document)
117	            do {
118	                switch graphic {
119	                case .template(let template):
120	                    return try GraphicPackageJob.template(template, document: document)
121	                case .project(let module):
122	                    return try GraphicPackageJob.project(named: module, document: document)
123	                }
124	            } catch let error as ReelCoreError {
125	                throw ToolError(message: error.message)
126	            }
127	        }
128	        let result: GraphicPackageResult
129	        do {
130	            result = try job.write(to: url)
131	        } catch let error as ReelCoreError {
132	            throw ToolError(message: error.message)
133	        }
134	        return try jsonResult([
135	            "path": result.url.path, "files": ["manifest.json"] + result.files,
136	            "frames": result.frames, "failed_frames": result.failedFrames,
137	        ])
138	    }
139	}

1	// app/Sources/ProjectDocument+GraphicInsert.swift — the two halves of
2	// Insert ▸ Graphic… that both doors share (spec §11 G-16, G-45 (f)): the
3	// sheet's Insert and From File… (`EditorViewController+GraphicMenus.swift`)
4	// and `insert_graphic` (`AgentServer+GraphicBrowser.swift`).
5	//
6	// `writeGraphicModule` is G-16 (b): a module's text copied into the
7	// package's `graphics/` under a free name, then the folder rescanned so the
8	// registry has compiled THAT text. `rescan()` runs here, from a command,
9	// never from a `.graphicsDidChange` observer (`drain()` is not re-entrant).
10	// The file write is not undoable (G-3).
11	//
12	// `graphicClipMaker` is the clip: `add_graphic_clip` at the module's `meta`
13	// duration and size, with the schema of its current revision (G-4). Where
14	// the clip goes is each caller's: `EditorViewController.generatedClipOps`,
15	// Add Text's rule (G-16 (a)). A module that does not compile places nothing
16	// and throws its first diagnostic (G-45 (f)).
17	
18	import Foundation
19	
20	extension ProjectDocument {
21	    /// The sentence for a document whose graphics store has not started —
22	    /// one with no window.
23	    static let noGraphicsFolderSentence =
24	        "This project has no graphics folder open (its window has not been made)"
25	
26	    /// Writes `url`'s module into `graphics/` under a free name made from
27	    /// its stem (G-16 (b)) and rescans; the name it was written under.
28	    /// Throws, writing nothing, when the file cannot be read or is not
29	    /// UTF-8.
30	    func writeGraphicModule(from url: URL) throws -> String {
31	        guard let store = graphicStore else {
32	            throw ReelCoreError(message: Self.noGraphicsFolderSentence)
33	        }
34	        let bytes: Data
35	        do {
36	            bytes = try Data(contentsOf: url)
37	        } catch {
38	            throw ReelCoreError(
39	                message: "\(url.path) could not be read: \(error.localizedDescription)")
40	        }
41	        guard let source = String(data: bytes, encoding: .utf8) else {
42	            throw ReelCoreError(
43	                message: "\(url.path) is not UTF-8 text — a graphic module must be UTF-8 "
44	                    + "JavaScript")
45	        }
46	        let name = store.uniqueModuleName(
47	            GraphicTemplates.moduleName(from: url.deletingPathExtension().lastPathComponent))
48	        try store.write(name: name, source: source)
49	        store.rescan()
50	        return name
51	    }
52	
53	    /// The op that places one clip drawn by `graphics/<name>.js` at a track
54	    /// and a time: its `meta` duration and size, its schema. Throws the
55	    /// module's first diagnostic when it does not compile, the store's
56	    /// sentence when the folder does not hold it, and the `meta` sentence
57	    /// when a duration or side is not a whole number in range.
58	    func graphicClipMaker(named name: String) throws -> (UInt32, Ticks) -> ReelOp {
59	        guard let store = graphicStore else {
60	            throw ReelCoreError(message: Self.noGraphicsFolderSentence)
61	        }
62	        guard let entry = GraphicRegistry.shared.entry(named: name, for: recipeKey) else {
63	            throw ReelCoreError(message: store.noModuleSentence(name))
64	        }
65	        guard case .compiled(_, _, let meta, let schema) = entry else {
66	            var first: GraphicDiagnostic?
67	            if case .failed(let diagnostics, _) = entry { first = diagnostics.first }
68	            let line = first?.line.map { " (line \($0))" } ?? ""
69	            throw ReelCoreError(
70	                message: "graphics/\(name).js does not compile: "
71	                    + (first?.message ?? "no diagnostic") + line)
72	        }
73	        let frame = max(project.snapshot.canvas.fps.frameDuration, 1)
74	        let duration: Ticks?
75	        let width: UInt32?
76	        let height: UInt32?
77	        do {
78	            duration = try AgentServer.metaWhole(
79	                meta, "durationInFrames", name, in: 1...Int.max / Int(frame)
80	            ).map { Ticks($0) * frame }
81	            width = try AgentServer.metaWhole(meta, "width", name, in: AgentServer.sides)
82	                .map(UInt32.init)
83	            height = try AgentServer.metaWhole(meta, "height", name, in: AgentServer.sides)
84	                .map(UInt32.init)
85	        } catch let error as AgentServer.ToolError {
86	            throw ReelCoreError(message: error.message)
87	        }
88	        return { track, at in
89	            .addGraphicClipRaw(
90	                track: track, at: at, duration: duration, name: name, width: width,
91	                height: height, props: nil, schema: schema)
92	        }
93	    }
94	}

**Frozen files.** `EditorViewController.swift`, `TimelineView.swift`,
`PreviewCanvasView.swift`, `AgentServer.swift` are **frozen at current
size**: anything adding more than ~50 lines goes in an extension file
(`EditorViewController+<Feature>.swift`, `TimelineView+<Feature>.swift`,
`AgentServer+<Feature>.swift`) or a new `…SheetController`, and the frozen
file keeps only the wiring — a stored property, a closure assignment, a
validator arm, a draw call. The pieces extension files build on are therefore
internal, not private. Pitfalls: a selector declared `@objc` on an extension
needs NO forward in the frozen file (a second declaration is an error); a
command whose body sits at the foot of a non-extension feature file carries
its validator arm there too, or the item falls through to the closing
`return true`; `handleEditorCharacter`'s bare-key `switch` matches in SOURCE
order, so a bare `case "x"` goes BELOW any modified `case "x" where …`; and
`handleEditorKey` refuses while a sheet is attached, because a sheet is
window-modal and the preview panel's forwarded keys would otherwise reach
the key map behind it.

//! G-5's sandbox (road map 10 §5b): the script evaluated after the standard
//! library that freezes the clock and removes randomness and every second
//! source of code, and the module loader that resolves no specifier.

use rquickjs::loader::{ImportAttributes, Loader, Resolver};
use rquickjs::module::Declared;
use rquickjs::Module;

/// The sentence an `import` of any specifier is refused with; QuickJS
/// prefixes it with `Error resolving module '<x>' from '<name>': `.
pub(crate) const IMPORT_REFUSAL: &str =
    "imports are not available in a graphic; the standard library is global";

/// Evaluated as a script, last: `Date` frozen at 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z (its
/// prototype's `constructor` too), `Math.random` throwing, `eval`,
/// `Function` and the three other function-kind constructors gone,
/// `WebAssembly` and `performance` (`JS_NewContext` installs a clock there)
/// deleted.
pub(crate) const SANDBOX: &str = r#"
(() => {
  const RealDate = Date;
  const EPOCH = 946684800000;
  function FrozenDate(...args) {
    if (!new.target) return new RealDate(EPOCH).toString();

180	    static func op(clips: [ClipSnapshot], props: [String: Any], schema: [String: Any]?) -> ReelOp {
181	        .setGraphicRaw(clips: clips.map(\.id), patch: ["props": props], schema: schema)
182	    }

184	    // MARK: - Rows
185	
186	    /// One schema entry's row. Every `read` answers the default in the
187	    /// binding's `.defaults` mode, so the builders' derived Reset works, and
188	    /// otherwise the binding's mode's value (the selected action's end, its
189	    /// start, the playhead); every write is `InspectorBinding.ops(graphic:…)`
190	    /// over `clips()`.
191	    static func row(
192	        _ entry: GraphicSchemaEntry, _ binding: InspectorBinding,
193	        clips: @escaping () -> [ClipSnapshot], schema: [String: Any],
194	        assets: @escaping () -> [String]
195	    ) -> NSView {
196	        let key = entry.key, name = "Graphic " + entry.label
197	        func stored() -> GraphicPropValue? {
198	            clips().first.map { binding.graphicProps($0)[key] } ?? nil
199	        }
200	        func current() -> GraphicPropValue { stored() ?? entry.default }
201	        func ops(_ value: GraphicPropValue) -> [ReelOp] {
202	            binding.ops(graphic: value, for: entry, clips: clips(), schema: schema)
203	        }
204	        let mixed = { binding.mixed(clips()) { binding.graphicProps($0)[key] } }
205	        let view: NSView
206	        switch entry.type {
207	        case "number":
208	            let fallback: Double = {
209	                if case .number(let number) = entry.default { return number }
210	                return 0
211	            }()
212	            let bounded = entry.min != nil && entry.max != nil
213	            view = inspectorValueRow(
214	                entry.label, binding, name: name,
215	                decimals: decimals(for: entry),
216	                min: entry.min ?? -1e9, max: entry.max ?? 1e9, slider: bounded,
217	                read: {
218	                    if case .number(let number) = current() { return number }
219	                    return fallback
220	                },
221	                ops: { ops(.number($0)) }, mixed: mixed)
222	        case "boolean":
223	            view = inspectorCheckRow(
224	                entry.label, binding, name: name,
225	                read: {
226	                    if case .bool(let bool) = current() { return bool }
227	                    if case .bool(let bool) = entry.default { return bool }
228	                    return false
229	                },
230	                ops: { ops(.bool($0)) }, mixed: mixed)
231	        case "color":
232	            view = inspectorColorRow(
233	                entry.label, binding, name: name,
234	                read: {
235	                    if case .string(let text)? = stored(), let color = rgba(css: text) {
236	                        return color
237	                    }
238	                    return defaultColor(entry)
239	                },
240	                ops: { ops(.string(css($0))) }, mixed: mixed)
241	        case "enum":
242	            let options = entry.options
243	            view = inspectorPopupRow(
244	                entry.label, binding, name: name, items: options,
245	                read: {
246	                    if case .string(let text) = current(), let index = options.firstIndex(of: text) {
247	                        return index
248	                    }
249	                    if case .string(let text) = entry.default,
250	                       let index = options.firstIndex(of: text)
251	                    {
252	                        return index
253	                    }
254	                    return 0
255	                },
256	                ops: { index in options.indices.contains(index) ? ops(.string(options[index])) : [] },
257	                mixed: mixed)
258	        case "asset":
259	            view = assetRow(entry, binding, name: name, clips: clips, assets: assets,
260	                            current: current, ops: ops, mixed: mixed)
261	        case "string":
262	            view = stringRow(entry, binding, name: name, current: current, ops: ops, mixed: mixed)
263	        default:
264	            view = inspectorRow(
265	                entry.label, [inspectorReadout { "type \"\(entry.type)\" is not supported" }])
266	        }
267	        view.toolTip = entry.help
268	        return view
269	    }
270	
271	    /// The asset popup: "None" first on every asset row (G-42 (d)), the
272	    /// folder's files, then any name a clip or the selected action's end
273	    /// holds (or the default names) that the folder does not. A `""`, a
274	    /// `null` or an unknown value reads as "None". "None" writes `null` at
275	    /// the base when the default is `null` and `""` when it is a string; an
276	    /// end takes `""` either way (`endValues`).
277	    private static func assetRow(
278	        _ entry: GraphicSchemaEntry, _ binding: InspectorBinding, name: String,
279	        clips: @escaping () -> [ClipSnapshot], assets: @escaping () -> [String],
280	        current: @escaping () -> GraphicPropValue,
281	        ops: @escaping (GraphicPropValue) -> [ReelOp], mixed: @escaping () -> Bool
282	    ) -> NSView {
283	        let names = assetNames(
284	            for: entry, files: assets(), clips: clips(),
285	            end: binding.selectedAction?.end.graphic?.props ?? [:])
286	        let items = ["None"] + names
287	        let offset = 1
288	        return inspectorPopupRow(
289	            entry.label, binding, name: name, items: items,
290	            read: {
291	                if case .string(let text) = current(), let index = names.firstIndex(of: text) {
292	                    return index + offset
293	                }
294	                return 0
295	            },
296	            ops: { index in
297	                if index == 0 { return ops(entry.default == .null ? .null : .string("")) }
298	                let at = index - offset
299	                return names.indices.contains(at) ? ops(.string(names[at])) : []
300	            },
301	            mixed: mixed)
302	    }
303	
304	    /// A string entry: a one-line field, or a text area when `multiline`.
305	    /// `OptionFieldControl` is numeric, so the row is assembled here with an
306	    /// explicit default rather than through `inspectorValueRow`.
307	    private static func stringRow(
308	        _ entry: GraphicSchemaEntry, _ binding: InspectorBinding, name: String,
309	        current: @escaping () -> GraphicPropValue,
310	        ops: @escaping (GraphicPropValue) -> [ReelOp], mixed: @escaping () -> Bool
311	    ) -> NSView {
312	        let read: () -> String = {
313	            if case .string(let text) = current() { return text }
314	            return ""
315	        }
316	        let write: (String) -> [ReelOp] = { ops(.string($0)) }
317	        let control: NSView = entry.multiline
318	            ? InspectorTextArea(
319	                read: read, write: { [weak binding] in binding?.apply(name, write($0)) },
320	                enabled: { true }, onEdit: { [weak binding] in binding?.edited() })
321	            : InspectorNameField(
322	                read: read, write: { [weak binding] in binding?.apply(name, write($0)) },
323	                enabled: { true }, onEdit: { [weak binding] in binding?.edited() })
324	        // Either control takes the row's width (`inspectorRow`, spec §11 G-48).
325	        return inspectorRow(
326	            entry.label, [control], mixed: mixed, binding: binding, writes: write(read()),
327	            discrete: true, default: .derived(binding, name: name, read: read, ops: write))
328	    }

330	    /// A stored key the schema no longer declares: the key dimmed, its value,
331	    /// and ⌫, which writes `{key: null}` — a null always removes (G-4).
332	    static func staleRow(
333	        key: String, value: GraphicPropValue, _ binding: InspectorBinding,
334	        clips: @escaping () -> [ClipSnapshot]
335	    ) -> NSView {
336	        let (label, readout) = staleLabels(key: key, value: value)
337	        let remove = OptionButtonControl(
338	            title: "⌫",
339	            action: { [weak binding] in
340	                let targets = clips()
341	                binding?.apply(
342	                    "Remove Graphic Property",
343	                    targets.isEmpty ? [] : [op(clips: targets, props: [key: NSNull()], schema: nil)])
344	            },
345	            enabled: { true }, onEdit: {})
346	        remove.toolTip = "The module no longer declares \(key) — remove the stored value"
347	        return inspectorRow(nil, [label, readout, remove])
348	    }
349	
350	    /// A key the selected action's END names that the schema no longer
351	    /// declares (G-34 (l), O2), or `declared` but not `animatable` (G-41 (c)):
352	    /// its row beside the clip's own, marked as the end's, with ⌫ taking it
353	    /// out of the end — `clearOps`, no schema.
354	    static func actionStaleRow(
355	        key: String, value: GraphicPropValue, declared: Bool, _ binding: InspectorBinding
356	    ) -> NSView {
357	        let (label, readout) = staleLabels(key: key, value: value)
358	        let ops = binding.clearOps(["graphic.props." + key])
359	        let remove = OptionButtonControl(
360	            title: "⌫",
361	            action: { [weak binding] in binding?.apply("Remove from Action", ops) },
362	            enabled: { true }, onEdit: {})
363	        let number = binding.selectedActionNumber.map { String($0) } ?? ""
364	        remove.toolTip = declared
365	            ? "The module does not let \(key) be animated — remove it from action \(number)"
366	            : "The module no longer declares \(key) — remove it from action \(number)"
367	        return inspectorRow(nil, [label, readout, remove], binding: binding, writes: ops)
368	    }
369	
370	    /// A stale row's key, dimmed, and its value.
371	    private static func staleLabels(
372	        key: String, value: GraphicPropValue
373	    ) -> (InspectorRowLabel, NSView) {
374	        let label = InspectorRowLabel(key)
375	        label.textColor = DS.textFaint
376	        label.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
377	        label.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: InspectorMetrics.labelWidth).isActive = true
378	        let shown: String
379	        switch value {
380	        case .string(let text): shown = "\"\(text)\""
381	        case .number(let number): shown = String(format: "%g", number)
382	        case .bool(let bool): shown = bool ? "true" : "false"
383	        case .null: shown = "null"
384	        }
385	        let readout = inspectorReadout(width: 110) { shown }
386	        readout.alphaValue = 0.55
387	        return (label, readout)
388	    }
389	}

## Fonts and pictures

**File ▸ Add Font to Graphics…** copies a `.ttf` or `.otf` file into the
project's `graphics/fonts/`. Every graphic in the project can then use it. A
file that loads no face is refused, and a file with the same name replaces
the old one. Nothing is shown when it works.

the file, which can differ from the name Font Book or other apps show. If a
font doesn't draw, the Source section reports the missing font; an agent's
`get_graphic {}` or `import_graphic_font` answer lists the exact family
names.
